xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5489: pan plan fails workspace creation when the caller's shell lacks HUME_API_KEY, and the error hides the cause

plan.title: pan plan fails workspace creation when the caller's shell lacks HUME_API_KEY, and the error hides the cause
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Workspace creation for a project with a workspace.hume block fails when the process running createWorkspace has no HUME_API_KEY. For pan plan that process is the dashboard (pan plan only POSTs /api/issues/:id/start-planning), not the caller's shell; the CLI already loads ~/.overdeck.env. The error says 'see steps for details' but no consumer prints the steps. createWorkspace clears the PAN-4171 setup marker even after the Hume step fails, so a retry treats the half-built workspace as finished and never writes .hume-config. Separately, POST /api/fleet/issues/:id/start (MCP start_issue) and the machine work door are not wrapped in httpHandler, and spawn-issue.ts wraps a rejecting Effect.promise in a try/catch that cannot catch it, so start failures become unlogged 500s with no error message.
narratives.Proposal: Resolve the Hume API key at point of use from process.env, then the project's workspace.env.secrets_file, then a fresh read of ~/.overdeck.env, passing it as a value and never writing process.env (WI-1). Put the failing step line in the workspace-creation error for Hume and tunnel via a small helper (WI-2). Keep the setup marker when the Hume step fails so the next create re-runs it (WI-3). Replace the dead try/catch around pan workspace create in spawn-issue with a never-rejecting helper that logs and returns the message (WI-4). Wrap both issue-start handlers in httpHandler and log the typed 500 errors (WI-5). Update docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md and add changelog.d/pan-5489.md (WI-6). Full detail with before/after code is in .pan/drafts/PAN-5489.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Restoring MYN's hume: block in ~/.overdeck/projects.yaml (operator configuration).
- Repairing existing workspaces already left without .hume-config and without a setup marker.
- Making a Hume failure non-fatal to workspace creation.
- Keeping the setup marker for tunnel, port, devcontainer or Docker failures.
- Writing project secrets_file keys into the dashboard's or the CLI's process.env.
- Changing how agent panes receive ~/.overdeck.env keys (PAN-5065).
- Adding a ~/.overdeck.env load to the CLI (src/cli/index.ts already loads it).
- Confirming the root cause of the two 2026-11-22 MCP start_issue 500s.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the Hume key lookup at point of use in src/lib/hume.ts instead of adding a CLI env load.
autoDecisions.rationale: dashboard.log shows createWorkspace and the Hume failure ran in the dashboard process for MIN-1142 and MIN-1144; src/cli/index.ts already loads ~/.overdeck.env, so a CLI change would be a no-op. The issue's 'verified cause' is a misdiagnosis, not a contradiction to escalate.

autoDecisions.summary: Key lookup order: process.env, then the project's secrets_file, then a fresh read of ~/.overdeck.env; empty string counts as absent.
autoDecisions.rationale: An explicit running-process value wins (matches loadOverdeckEnv's no-override rule); the project file is more specific than the global file; a fresh read covers a dashboard that booted before the key was added.

autoDecisions.summary: Only a failed Hume step keeps the PAN-4171 setup marker.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Hume step is idempotent (reuses a config with the same name) and its output .hume-config is what a retry must produce; keeping the marker for every soft failure would make a persistent port or devcontainer warning fail every later start.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the tunnel step's identical 'see steps for details' error text too, without changing its marker behavior.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same defect, same file, same helper; costs one line.

autoDecisions.summary: Prove acceptance at the unit boundary rather than with the issue's env -u pan plan command.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan plan runs creation in the dashboard, which env -u in the caller's shell does not affect, and MYN's live projects.yaml currently has no hume: block.

autoDecisions.summary: Wrap handleFleetIssueStart and handleWorkIssueStart in httpHandler inside the exported functions, and log the typed 500 errors in httpHandler.
autoDecisions.rationale: Meets the issue comment's ask (log server-side, return the message) and keeps the existing direct-call tests able to assert the 500 mapping without a router.

autoDecisions.summary: Move the spawn-issue workspace-create call into a new module.
autoDecisions.rationale: spawn-issue.ts is at 955 of the 1000-line ceiling; the helper is also easier to unit test outside the route's service graph.

Write tests/unit/lib/hume-api-key.test.ts with temp HOME, stubbed env and stubbed fetch (immediate responses).
